dog.description_text:
Sex: Male

Age: 3 years old

Breed: Jindo mix

Description: large size dog with long brown and black fur

Health: Spayed/neutered, Vaccinated

Temperament: Good with children, playful, athletic, affectionate, silly.

Meet Sanji - an adoptable 3 year old male dog with a lot of love to give! He's friendly, affectionate, playful, smart, protective, loyal, curious, brave, independent and funny. He's athletic and enjoys kisses. If you're interested in adopting Sanji, please keep in mind that he needs owners who can accommodate his needs and give him a loving home. He is a young dog who needs lots of attention and exercise. Sanji's previous home had no dogs and is working with a trainer now. He may be best as the only dog in the household. If you live in the New York City, Long Island, or New Jersey area, we encourage you to come and meet Sanji today!
dog.name: Sanji
